connector.name: SecurityScan
connector.registryDescription: Scan GitHub-hosted AI skills for vulnerabilities: prompt injection, malware, OWASP LLM Top 10.
connector.summary: Hosted at apisecurityscan.net over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace net.apisecurityscan, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.description: SecurityScan API key (ss_live_...). Register free at https://apisecurityscan.net/auth/register — no payment needed for FREE tier (5 scans/month).
